measure.label: Median gross annual pay · full-time employees

coverageNote: Workplace-based United Kingdom occupation groups. Full-time employee jobs on adult rates, in the same job for more than a year; tax year ended 5 April 2025. Excludes self-employment. Not starting salaries or current advertised pay.
qualityNote: A dot in the CV workbook means that the quality score is unavailable. A separately published numeric median is retained with a caution. Suppressed or blank medians are never estimated.
